honors.title: National Science Foundation S-STEM Scholarship
honors.description:
A prestigious National Science Foundation award to provide scholarships for FIU physics majors. Scholarships of up to $10,000 per year for up to 4 years are awarded to eligible majors who continue to qualify based on their academic performance and financial need each year.

Students who are chosen as FIU S-STEM Scholars receive one-on-one mentoring and advising, and are expected to participate in at least two events each semester, including special seminars by guest speakers.
honors.issuer: Issued by National Science Foundation · Aug 2016
